owasp_testing_project.name: OWASP Testing Project / Web Security Testing Guide

selection_policy.fresh_pool_selection: Existing unscored v6 discovery pools may be re-audited against these WSTG/OWASP and write-up semantic boundaries; the source firewall remains mandatory and unchanged.

business_logic.semantic_boundary: Require an observed workflow, value, state, or invariant violation; workflow naming alone is surface evidence only.

cors_misconfiguration.semantic_boundary: Require unsafe origin policy plus credentialed or sensitive cross-origin impact; permissive-looking headers alone are insufficient.

dom_xss.semantic_boundary: Require a traceable attacker-controlled browser source reaching an executable or HTML sink without effective sanitization.

graphql_data_exposure.semantic_boundary: Require sensitive fields to cross the caller's actual field/property policy; schema or field-name visibility alone is insufficient.

improper_inventory_management.semantic_boundary: Require a stale, undocumented, deprecated, beta, or legacy deployment that remains reachable with weaker controls, real data, or security drift.

nosql_injection.semantic_boundary: Require structured attacker input to become NoSQL/document-query operators or otherwise alter document-query logic.

postmessage_trust.semantic_boundary: Require attacker-controlled cross-window messaging to reach sensitive behavior when sender origin/source validation is insufficient.

sensitive_business_flow_abuse.semantic_boundary: Require a sensitive business operation whose anti-automation, frequency, sequencing, or usage-limit control is absent or bypassable.

sensitive_caching.semantic_boundary: Require sensitive or authenticated content whose caching policy permits retention, shared-cache exposure, or cross-context reuse.

software_supply_chain_failure.semantic_boundary: Require untrusted, compromised, stale, or attacker-influenced supply-chain input to affect a privileged build, dependency, artifact, component, or update path.
